notes.title: GTTZ V 1.1.0.5 BETA - a patch for saves
notes.content:
Hey everyone,


this update should fix the save-issue introduced in the last beta-update.

To reiterate, I've ported the game to a new version of GMS2, so performance should be better.
I've tested it, so most crashes should be fixed? The engine handles particles in a different way, so I'm not a 100 percent sure.

But there are some actual fixes in here, too. Like (as previously mentioned):

[h3] ːsteamthumbsupː Guns will now reload on their own if you keep jamming the fire button! ːsteamthumbsupː [/h3]

How soon this delayed reload will occur depends on the chosen difficulty.

Also, a few bug fixes regarding reloading and player-select.
A few really small changes to balancing..

AND the first heart-container in the campaign (level 2) will now always show up, loot-luck be damned. 
It is tucked away in a cornfield, just after crossing the bridge, right before the entrance to the forest.


Thanks, that's it for this update ːsummersunː

notes.title: GTTZ V 1.1.0.5 in BETA
notes.content:
Hello,

just a small update for the game. If you want it, set your game to receive beta-updates!

But beware: progression will start from scratch. I've ported the game to a new version of the engine and I'm currently investigating if previous saves are not compatible.

Good news is that your old save will not get overwritten, so you can go back to the previous (non-beta) build.


[b]What does this actually do?[/b]

[list]
[*] Well, it's a new version of the engine, so it should run better. 
[*] There are a few smaller tweaks and bugfixes
[*] One commonly requested features is added: 
[/list]

[h1]Guns will now reload on their own if you keep jamming the fire button! Yay![/h1]

How soon this delayed reload will occur depends on the chosen difficulty.


See you next update! ːTheRoosterː

notes.title: The future of Gun to the Zone
notes.content:
Hey there!

A new update has just released after being in beta for a while. I'll also talk about the future of this game a little bit.

Here's the deal:

[h1]Patchnotes for V 1.1.0.4[/h1]

- Fixed a possible crash on startup on Steam Deck.
- Yes, this game runs on Steam Deck. It is using Proton. The game looks pretty good on an OLED ;)
- Made some of the maps a little easier
- It should be more feasible now to play Arenas 1 and 2 up to difficulty 15-20
- Renamed some of the entries in the main menu to more accurately reflect the map and mode
- Don't like the look of a hat? Toggle hats by pressing H on the keyboard, or Back/Select on a controller
- The impact effects (particles) should be a little better now
- Changed some of the firing-mechanics a little bit, regarding ejecting spent bullets/shells
- You can no longer single-reload SMGs, as that was a little weird and unfun
- Added a "gun ready" sound for certain guns, like slow-firing shotguns
- Added a "gun almost empty" sound
- Lowered the volume of certain sounds
- Made the default "flashlight" less visible in well lit environments
- Changed the way certain hats work
- The -fake- loading screens can now be skipped with any keyboard input, or start on a controller
- You were already able to skip this screen before, using "A" on a controller, or a click
- You can also skip the intro screens by pressing a button on the controller or clicking
- Added an additional (spread-) shot type to certain guns.
- Very minor tweaks to some maps and graphics
- Some additional bugfixes
- Some additional changes to balancing

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44228808/eae5b39be38382b4c919bf8a6d5c84a2b1e8a8e9.png[/img]

In addition, I want to make another, bigger update. But these things take time. And I also want to maybe make another game soon!

Anyway, here are my thoughts on that, in roadmap-form?!


[h1]-> Still to come (timing tbd): [/h1]

- A different song / atmosphere for the main menu will be tested
- I want to add a friendly fire-option (2 additional hats) to the game
- If everything works out, you could potentially use this to play some sort of deathmatch in this game :)
- Some of the hats dealing with slo-mo don't really work all that well, they will hopefully be fixed
- I want to add some more weapons and bullet-types to the game
- As well as some additional enemy types, but this will require a LOT of testing
- MAYBE there will be a major redesign of the main menu
- ..I'm thinking of some more options to get the artifacts (2 maps per artifact, instead of one)
- MAYBE I'll do an entirely new, exploration based game type. This will also require a lot of testing.
- As I'm only working on this on the weekends and during holidays, these things will take a while.


Have fun!

notes.title: Gun to the Zone Version 1.1
notes.content:
Welcome back! After a lot of work, the latest update is finally released. What's in it? Quite a bit of stuff:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44228808/be5c2c08ed16ad2dabe761d98469be4ee5f284ce.png[/img]

[h2]With a Little Help From My (Drone-) Friends[/h2]

You have a little floating friend around, who will automatically fire at enemies. However, you will not be able to rely on this little friend 100% of the time. It can use all the weapons that are in your inventory. Some weapons are more accurate than others, of course.

Every buff you collect will also buff your little drone-friend. If you focus on fewer weapons, the drone will be more effective, but won't fire as often.

You can turn the drone off, but accessing the settings for the individual arenas in the main menu (right click or Y on the controller). In certain bonus rooms, the drone is deactivated by default.



[h2]A Forest[/h2]

Some of the trees in the game have changed. They appeared pixelated before, now they're a lot more cohesive and fit in with the rest of the graphics.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44228808/e1e231b277dd14d8781a0cc4e5a83214725065ce.png[/img]




[h2]Easy Now[/h2]

The game will be easier and more accessible, especially as you first start it. For example, your guns will be a little easier to aim, your special attack will charge faster and you have an additional heart from the start.

You are also able to collect more hearts right from the start. The campaign will also be shorter on lower difficulties.

However, if you want to beat the final boss, you might have to replay levels at higher difficulties. As soon as you've completed one of the levels in the main menu, its default difficulty will automatically go up.




[h2]Intergalactic[/h2]

There is a new gametype in the main menu: In this one, you will be constantly attacked by zombies. There will be no time to relax in this mode. It is pretty fun, especially with a helper drone!



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44228808/127e48930499bb24f6551b1a61bbe8c1c694c9c8.jpg[/img]



[h2]Somewhere Only We Know[/h2]

There are some new places to explore! Two new levels are accessible in the campaign. The first arena level has also changed. As mentioned before, the new level in the main menu also has a different theme. The old "dark forest" arena is now found in the bonus menu.

There are some new bonus-maps as well. Check em out!





[h2]The Long and Winding Road[/h2]

There are a lot of other changes in this update, check it out for yourself. Or read the changelog below. 

For example, there are some new weapon-variants and skins, some polish to menus and other things, as well as A LOT of bugfixes.

The game will get more updates. Contact me if you have suggestions or problems!

Anyway, I'm very grateful that I was able to launch a game on Steam this year! I could not have imagined this a couple of years ago when I started to make games in my spare time.
Who knows what the future holds, probably more games though.



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44228808/eae5b39be38382b4c919bf8a6d5c84a2b1e8a8e9.png[/img]



[h2]The List Goes On[/h2]

[b]The full changelog for V 1.1.0.0 & V 1.1.0.1[/b]
- Added an optional helper drone that shoots the same projectiles you can shoot
- Adjusted the time it takes to aim down sights to be snappier
- Added one additional hp, giving players 5 hearts at the start
- Added "always auto reload" mutator to certain hats
- Adjusted scoring across the board, you now score less in certain modes, or when using a helper drone
- Added two additional levels to the campaign. They are accessible at higher difficulties
- Replaced one of the four standard arena maps and updated the first arena map to a different tileset
- The fourth arena map will now be a different gametype, called onslaught
- The new gametype has no breaks in between waves, making it a bit more challenging
- Added additional arenas to the bonus maps, replacing some of the more redundant maps
- Rework of the Onslaught gametype to be a bit more manageable
- Added four weapon-skins to the pool of weapons
- Adjusted weapon balance regarding charge-type weapons
- It should now be easier to hit stuff with these charging guns, provided you're not moving too much
- Added a level-up indicator in the main menu
- Changed the way menus look and the way the blur filter is applied.
- Certain fixes and changes to tilesets. The big trees should be less pixelated now.
- Fixed a long standing bug where the reload-bar would freeze in certain conditions
- Fixed a rare crash involving exploding barrels and fire
- Slightly changed the way gamepad controls work

- Changed the way HP is displayed
- The player (P1) will now cast light cone to increase visibility.
- Slightly rebalanced the gunner and mortar enemies
- Made the standard zombie's blood a little less distracting
- Fixed a bug where a boss could have negative health and still be alive
- Fixed some bugs with the final boss
- You should now always start a new zone with max ammo
- Changed the way the "accuracy" buff works - it should now be a bit stronger
- All the passive buffs now add up to buff the drone
- If you pick up a boost-card, the level of your drone goes up (it does a little more damage)
- Your drone (and also other players) can no longer blow up health-pickups
- Changed the way the drone fires
- Changed progression in campaign / story mode - it will now be shorter on lower difficulties
- The underground arena is now displayed as the -hardest- arena
- The underground arena has also recieved a nerf and is now only 10 rounds
- The underground area bosses give -some- hp back
- The second wave-based arena was slightly changed - more boss encounters, more chances for hp
- Slightly lowered the challenge of the onslaught level
- Lowered a lot of the level-requirements in the store
- You can now pick up HP, even if you're at max hp - up to an absolute maximum of 14 hearts
- The info-box that shows up when you first pick up a gun now stays on screen a bit longer
- Your active hat will again be saved in between sessions
- Some menu items should be a little easier to see now
- The main menu now always fades up from black - the game only fades to white once, on first start
- Various little changes to UI / font and item / enemy placement

- Additional minor bug fixes and adjustments



Thank you all so much for playing!

Matt

notes.title: Gun to the Zone V 1.0.0.3
notes.content:
Hey Wanderers,

this is the first bigger update for the game, with some more to come soon.

Here are the changes:

[h1]Changelog for V 1.0.0.3[/h1]

- Implemented scale-factor for windowed resolutions: 1x or 2x
- Fullscreen and window-scale will now be saved in between sessions
- Fullscreen should now properly scale, even on ultrawide - it used to stretch the image.
- Implemented some more variety in gun-generation
- Enemies: The "Mage" should now be a bit more challenging - it will emit some projectiles when dying
- Enemies: The "Runner" should take a little longer to start running at you. 
- It makes a distinct sound as it spawns, then has to wait a bit before attacking.
- Raised thresholds for camera-movement in relation to cursor
- This should let you see a little more of the action, while hopefully not causing any nausea.
- Additional bug-fixes




[h1]My gun just changed?[/h1]

You might have noticed your standard gun changing. This was already part of the previous patch. Now, it was slightly tweaked.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44228808/8c115bfeb83a4f2c650a62462274f33d9e263595.png[/img]

Basically, your standard pistol gets stronger as you progress in the game. If you collect an artifact, the gun gets stronger. If you level up to 30, 60, 90 and so forth, the gun also gets stronger. There is a limit to exactly how strong it will be.. but that limit is removed once you've beaten the game!

So, go out there and shred with your new, extended arsenal. That's right, as part of this update, there are some new looks for guns and some new variations!





[h1]Known issues[/h1]

There are a few bugs remaining, regarding scaling in full screen. With this patch the game should no longer be stretched out to fill an ultrawide monitor. But, if you are playing on an ultrawide, you might see some HUD-elements where they don't belong.

If you encounter any issues with this version of the game, the previous version is available as a beta branch, so you can go back to that one.


That's it for this week. See you in the Zone!

notes.title: GTTZ is now available
notes.content:
Congratulations! You just discovered GTTZ. The game is now finally on Steam. The whole team at Endut Games could not be any more proud.

We sincerely hope you enjoy this little game. We had a lot of fun creating it.

Now for the FAQ:

[list]
[*] Does this run on Steam Deck?
[*] Yes! It definitely runs on ours. Pretty well, actually. It uses Proton, so no native Linux port, sorry.

[*] Is this game finished, or Early Access?
[*] We consider this 1.0 - a finished game, that will take most people hours to finish. However, we do plan on updating the game if there is demand for more features. And there might be some bugs to squash :)

[*] This looks like Brotato or something. Is it a bullet hell survival?
[*] Nah, this is more oldschool. A top down shooter. But there are some rogue-lite elements to it!

[*] I don't like arcade games. Is this any good?
[*] This is not really an arcade game, you're not competing for points. There is a goal, a final boss. The game just takes a more unconventional approach with its structure.

[*] Well, what IS this structure you're talking about?
[*] There are five items on the main menu that you need to beat in order to finish the game. You'll figure it out.

[/list]

Have fun with the game! And let us know in the comments if anything is wrong.

Endut Games

notes.title: Gun to the Zone awaits
notes.content:
We're getting pretty excited over here!

The wait is finally over. Gun to the Zone is about to release.

This was started all the way back in 2019, then picked up again during the pandemic. You could say it is VERY polished now. But that's definitely a matter of personal taste.


A few tips before we go:

[list]
[*] There is a lot of weird stuff in this game. Some of it is hidden. Like the intro. Just wait at the title screen.
[*] If you stand still for a while, the characters will do stuff. They'll even celebrate if you've completed a wave or a level.
[*] The game might be too easy (or too hard) for you. But you can press the right mouse button / the triangle or Y button on a controller to flip the cards in the main menu, revealing additional options, including difficulty.
[*] If you've finished one of the modes.. go back in, things will be a bit harder. This might even help you later on!
[*] This game is designed to be beaten with just 4 hearts / HP.. but you can buy more for gold! You collect gold as you go and earn it for good runs, so no microtransactions here!
[*] You can play this game with 3 other people. Just press -Start- on the other controllers at character selection.. we even tested this feature, just not THAT extensively. It'll work, trust us.
[/list]


Keep these in mind. And enjoy GTTZ!
